title: Arrow
paragraphs: “Boo… Sakura wants to go with Naofumi and the others.”
“Kou too… I want to play with Rifana.”

“Endure it. It’s very frustrating, but this is a matter where we need to negotiate with the dragon… No, once this is over, the dragon will fall under our control… It’s a roundabout way of showing that we are superior.”
“Hmm? What do you mean?”
“Since it’s being forced to grant us a class-up beyond the limit for the sake of strengthening us, it’s the ultimate humiliation for the dragon.”
Yuki-chan explained this to Sakura-chan and Kou with a smug laugh.
Oh! As expected of Yuki-chan, she’s so clever.
“That’s a bit dark.”
“True. Beneath their innocent appearance, there’s always a bit of darkness mixed in. That’s what Filolials are.”
“In Ren’s case, Kuro is completely a dark past, right?”
“Ugh!? That has nothing to do with this.”
Ren stammered as he tried to respond to Itsuki’s words. While soothing Yuki-chan and the others, I listened to their exchange.
“Going on a picnic in the mountains! Sounds fun!”
“Yeah!”
“There might be strong monsters, so be extra careful, okay? It’s a promise between you and big sister and Naofumi-chan.”
“Okay!”
“Well then… Shall we go? Motoyasu, you know the way, right?”
“Of course. Let’s get going.”

I took the lead and began walking to guide the way. The eastern village was completely untouched by destruction, just like last time. Well, the people there are still rotten to the core, but there’s no point in dealing with them now. As before, I was heading to the place where the rival’s parent was supposed to die. However, on the way, even I began to sense something was off.
“…This is strange.”
Itsuki noticed it first.
“What is?”
“We’ve been walking deep into the mountains, but we haven’t encountered a single monster.”
“Now that you mention it… that’s true.”
“Maybe they sensed the strength of us heroes?”
“Even so, isn’t it weird? I mean, not even a single one has shown up.”
“That’s true.”
Last time, monsters appeared and attacked us. Yet now, there’s not even the slightest trace of any monsters.
“As long as we’re walking like this, it just feels like a peaceful mountain.”
“Yeah, it’s really tranquil.”
Big sister and her big sister answered while looking around the mountain.
Indeed. It looks like a bunch of heroes casually going on a hike.
“Motoyasu, do you know anything about this?”
“I have no idea.”

This is the first time something like this has happened. Come to think of it, lately, we haven’t encountered any wild dragons in Melromarc. Even though I’ve been searching everywhere for dragon treasures and experience points, I haven’t found a single one. For now, we’ve been venturing to other countries and fighting deep in the mountains.
“Hmm… Maybe this is the time to be more cautious. Everyone, stay alert. I’ll make sure not to let my Meteor Shield drop.”
“Naofumi-san is really useful, isn’t he?”
“He’s handy because he can react to surprise attacks.”
“If we were just relying on game knowledge, it would seem ridiculous, but when I see him protecting us like this, I can’t help but admire him.”
“Cut the flattery. Only being able to take hits is pretty inconvenient, you know?”
“I get it. Just being a punching bag and enduring it all would build up a lot of stress, so I respect that.”
“I feel like you just said something terrible.”
Father slumped his shoulders in defeat.
“Don’t worry. Rifana-chan, Raphtalia-chan, and big sister Sadina will fight in your place.”
“Yeah!”
“That’s right. Naofumi-chan can only defend, but when he goes hunting with us, he’s really helpful.”
“I thought it was amazing how he took the charge of that giant fish monster and supported big sister Sadina’s attack.”
Big sister’s friend praised Father as if it were her own achievement. Exactly, exactly. Father truly is the strongest.
“Rifana-chan and Raphtalia-chan are working hard too. Let’s stay cautious as we move forward.”
Just like last time, we were on our way to the place where the rival’s parent was supposed to appear.
“Father, I’ll leave the negotiations to you.”
“Yeah, I got it. Motoyasu, make sure to have the negotiation gift ready.”
“Of course, I have it with me.”

Anticipating this situation, I had packed the core extracted from Takt’s dragon in a pouch. I had personally sealed it with magic to keep it in a locked state. Even if it somehow fell out of my hands, it wouldn’t be easy to break the seal. If, by any chance, Takt’s dragon were to go berserk in its core state, I’d crush it immediately. That’s how tightly I sealed it while carrying it around. The thing we have to be most careful about is that monsters with dragon traits might try to steal it. There’s a risk of them taking control.
“Well then… Once we arrive at the designated location, let’s wait until they show up.”
With that, we reached the open area where the rival’s parent was supposed to die… and tilted our heads in confusion.
“Huh?”
“What’s this?”
“Umm…?”

Father and the others all turned their gaze toward me. I tilted my head as well. The place where the rival’s parent was supposed to be dead was a slight depression, but… there was an unfamiliar arrow carved into the ground. And where the arrow pointed, there was a shield-shaped mark with a heart engraved in the center.
“What is this?”
“I don’t think we’ll be able to figure out something that even Motoyasu doesn’t understand.”
“Naofumi-san, should we wait?”
“Hmm… For now, let’s wait a little longer, and if nothing happens, we’ll just follow the arrow.”
“This reeks of a trap. I’d like to think it’s just some random prank, but that’s probably not the case.”
And so, we waited for a while to see if the rival’s parent would appear. However, there was no sign of them at all. Last time, they showed up right away…
We kept waiting while making small talk, but it was starting to get tedious.
“Guess there’s no helping it. Let’s go scout the cave where the assistant is supposed to be. It might get a little complicated, but it’s their fault for making us wait.”
“Yeah. We can’t afford to waste time… Alright, let’s go.”
“Finally. I was starting to think we should just head back to the village.”
“This is a negotiation, so we’re not really needed, are we?”
“Now that I think about it, why are we even here? Wouldn’t it be better if we just went back?”
“Don’t say something so discouraging. You could just tag along, couldn’t you?”
Father glanced at Ren and Itsuki with half-lidded eyes.
“We get it.”
“Considering who we’re dealing with… that assistant is also intriguing.”
“That’s true. We’ll leave the situation to you, but we’ll enjoy watching from the sidelines.”
Father looked at Ren and Itsuki with a completely exasperated expression.
“Sigh… You’re just planning to enjoy watching from the sidelines… Well, I guess it’s better than not coming along.”
With that, we started walking in the direction the arrow pointed. Along the way, thoughts of the egg that seemed to contain the rival kept crossing my mind. No way.
Could it be that the rival got ahead of us? Physically, that should be impossible.
Could a rival, now a wild dragon, rise to this level in such a short time? It’s probably just my imagination. As I was thinking that, the arrow led us to the nest of the rival’s parent.
“Uh… Is this the place?”
“Looks like we’re being completely invited, aren’t we?”
“Yeah. We don’t know what’s waiting for us, but we have no choice but to go.”
“I have a bad feeling about this.”
With that uneasy feeling… we looked inside the nest. For some reason, the cave had been dug out even more since the last time we came, and it had turned into something like a large hall.
Where’s the treasure? And where’s the rival’s parent? If I remember correctly, the rival’s parent’s harem should be here. In the back… I saw something that looked like a large stone throne.
“…Naa~no. Did you come while I was eating~no?”
An unpleasant voice echoed from the direction of the throne.
“This… seems to be the wrong place. Come on, Father, we should leave quickly.”
“Mo-Motoyasu? That suspiciously blatant attitude is really bothering me…”
“Ah, I hear something.”
“Is it a dangerous monster?”
“In a way, that’s correct.”

Suddenly, all the torches mounted on the walls of the cave lit up at once, and mysterious lights appeared on the ceiling. The atmosphere was completely like the appearance of a demon lord in some RPG.
“Welcome, na~no!”
As the lights illuminated the area, sitting on the large stone throne was… a dragon.
